content.text: Selling digital products in countries restricted by [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/stripe-alternatives-nigerian-creators-honest-side-side-breakdown-3|Stripe Alternatives]], PayPal, Gumroad, Lemon Squeezy, and Paddle can be a daunting task. In Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, and other countries, a [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-methods-filipino-digital-creators-trap-most-creators|payment]] processor ban can be a devastating blow to a business. When a PayPal account is suspended, funds may be held for up to 180 days with no appeal, leaving creators without access to their earnings. The lack of [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-selling-music-online-accepting-bitcoin|COREMERCH guide to infrastructure]] sovereignty forces digital sellers to rely on external services that can be revoked at any moment. This post highlights the key differences between various Lemon Squeezy alternatives for restricted countries, focusing on infrastructure, fees, and ownership.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: The Complete Guide to Selling Digital Products Without Stripe at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/comparing-real-options-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Lemon squeezy

While Lemon Squeezy offers a user-friendly interface and a range of payment options, its restrictions on certain countries limit its appeal. Gumroad, another popular platform, allows creators to sell digital products but charges higher fees and has more stringent requirements for sellers. PayPal, although widely available, has a history of account suspensions and holds on funds, making it unreliable for some creators. In contrast, NOWPayments and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offer a more comprehensive solution, integrating multiple payment gateways and enabling infrastructure sovereignty for digital sellers.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Stripe operates in 46 countries, leaving a significant number of countries without access to its services. PayPal has a similar issue, with account suspensions and holds on funds affecting creators worldwide. Gumroad and Lemon Squeezy have even more restrictive policies, limiting sales to specific countries or regions. In contrast, NOWPayments and Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provide a bridge for restricted countries, allowing creators to sell digital products and receive payments without relying on external services.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

NOWPayments offers fast payment processing and competitive fees, with transaction fees as low as 0.5%. In contrast, Gumroad charges higher fees, up to 3.5% per transaction, and PayPal's fees can range from 2.9% to 5.4% depending on the country and type of transaction. Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a more affordable option, integrating multiple payment gateways and enabling infrastructure sovereignty for digital sellers.
NOWPayments offers a more affordable option for payment processing than Gumroad or PayPal.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

The asymmetric risk of platform dependency becomes concrete only when the platform acts. While a PayPal or Stripe account is functioning normally, the risk feels theoretical and distant. When it stops functioning — through suspension, policy change, or geographic restriction enforcement — the creator loses their revenue channel instantly, often with funds already inside the platform that cannot be withdrawn. The conventional appeals process rarely reverses these decisions because the original decision was made algorithmically and the human review process operates on the platform's timeline and criteria, not yours. Sovereign infrastructure eliminates this asymmetry entirely. Your Cloudflare Pages storefront cannot be suspended by a payment processor's compliance decision. Your wallet cannot be frozen by anyone.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

For creators in restricted countries, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a comprehensive solution, integrating multiple payment gateways and enabling infrastructure sovereignty. NOWPayments provides a more affordable option, with fast payment processing and competitive fees. When choosing a platform, consider the specific needs of your business, including the countries you operate in, the types of digital products you sell, and the level of control you require over your sales data and product delivery.
How do I sell digital products if Stripe is not available in my country?

Platform restrictions are not a customer service problem — they are an infrastructure problem. You cannot solve an infrastructure problem by calling support or finding the right contact at Stripe or PayPal. You solve it by building on infrastructure that was not designed around those restrictions in the first place. NOWPayments operates on blockchain rails — it has no correspondent banking relationships, no AML corridors to approve, and no geographic risk model that flags your country. It verifies transactions on-chain and fires a webhook. Your Cloudflare Worker or Apps Script receives the webhook and processes the order. The entire sequence is independent of any conventional financial institution.
Edge Commerce Stack ($197) provides a comprehensive solution for infrastructure sovereignty and digital product sales.

Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and NOWPayments, follow these steps: Set up a GitHub Pages site to host your digital products; Configure Cloudflare Pages and Workers to handle payment processing and automation; Integrate NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages and Workers to enable fast and secure payment processing; Test and deploy your Edge Commerce Stack ($197) to ensure seamless customer experiences and efficient order fulfillment; Monitor and optimize your infrastructure to ensure scalability and growth.
Frequently Asked Questions

NOWPayments is a payment gateway that enables fast and secure payment processing, while Edge Commerce Stack ($197) is a comprehensive solution that integrates multiple payment gateways and enables infrastructure sovereignty for digital sellers.

Yes, Gumroad is available in many countries, but it charges higher fees and has more stringent requirements for sellers, making it a less attractive option for some creators.

To set up Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and NOWPayments, follow the steps outlined in the checklist above, including setting up a GitHub Pages site, configuring Cloudflare Pages and Workers, and integrating NOWPayments with your Cloudflare Pages and Workers.
What are the fees associated with NOWPayments and Edge Commerce Stack ($197)?
NOWPayments charges a transaction fee of 0.5%, while Edge Commerce Stack ($197) offers a more comprehensive solution with competitive fees and infrastructure sovereignty for digital sellers.
Can I automate the delivery process with Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and NOWPayments?
Yes, Edge Commerce Stack ($197) and NOWPayments enable automation and delivery of digital products, allowing for seamless customer experiences and efficient order fulfillment.
